offering_description.value: Organizes and runs business-to-business trade shows, conferences and events in specific industries, bringing together exhibiting companies and trade buyers. It earns money from exhibitor booth space, sponsorships and attendee registrations.

primary_services.value: trade show organizing; industry conferences; exhibitor marketing; digital event services

customer_segment.value: B2B: exhibiting manufacturers, brands and service companies, trade buyers such as retailers and distributors

end_markets.value: jewelry; retail; beauty; outdoor recreation; waste and recycling

revenue_model.value: service fees: exhibitor booth space and event sponsorships; transaction or usage fees: attendee registration fees
revenue_model.category: service fees; transaction or usage fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: runs events for exhibitors and attendees, takes in booth and sponsorship fees and sells to exhibiting companies

geography_served.value: US national: mainly shows held in US cities such as Las Vegas, New York, Miami and Orlando, with some international events

specialization.value: diversified: separate event portfolios in jewelry, retail, beauty, outdoor, waste and other industries, each with different customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales teams selling booth space and sponsorships to exhibitors; online: event websites, digital registration and online content for attendees

regulatory_exposure.value: low: only normal business rules and venue safety and local event permit requirements apply

notes: The event portfolio changes over time, so some shows named here may have been sold or added.
